verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention policy, retention window, or deletion control for submitted audio, transcripts, or job data. The only delete endpoint removes custom Vocabulary Assets, which is an adjacent feature. Writing batch outputs to the customer's own S3 prefix is user-side storage, not a product retention control, and canceling a job is not deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
